title: parser strict.go
description: Reads one declaration document. It refuses a second document, an anchor, an alias, a merge key, a non-string mapping key and a duplicate key. It refuses a field that the declaration types do not declare. It holds the 4 MiB size limit and the 128 level nesting limit.

title: types types.go
description: Declares the shape of a declaration. The archetype is one string field, so a declaration can select one archetype only. Collections decode from a named map, so each collection name occurs one time.

title: compiler validate.go
description: Holds the semantic stage. validateSource is the one gate for the validate, plan and apply commands. It collects each fault in a ValidationResult and does not stop at the first fault. It reads the declaration and the registry only; it writes no file. It checks the archetype, entity and field names, constraints, collection names and entity references, slot names, slot operators and slot consumption.

title: compiler config.go
description: Checks each component setting against the schema of the component. It refuses a setting that the schema does not declare, a setting on a component that is not active, a value of the wrong type and a value outside a declared value set. It also checks each default value in the registry.

title: compiler init.go
description: Writes the first declaration. It stops when service.yaml is already present, and it creates each file with an exclusive create, so it replaces no existing file. It refuses an archetype that the registry does not hold and names every archetype the registry holds.

title: compiler reconciler.go
description: Builds the plan. Before it generates, it calls the same validateSource function that the validate command calls, so generation and checking use one set of rules.

title: stego CLI declaration commands
description: Holds the init, validate and registry commands. The validate command prints the fault list and writes no file. The registry inspect command reports the settings and the slots of one component. It loads the registry with the same loader that checking uses.

title: registry registry.go
description: Loads every archetype, component and mixin declaration from the registry directories. The registry commands and the semantic stage both read this one loader, so the report and the check cannot disagree about what a component declares.

title: state.go
description: Reads and writes .stego/state.yaml. It saves the record as plain YAML text. It rejects a state file whose input manifest disagrees with the recorded service hash or registry reference.

title: transaction.go
description: Applies output through a journal in .stego/transaction.yaml. It saves the state record last. It refuses a transaction that leaves output untracked. It skips every file the plan marks unchanged.

title: drift.go
description: Compares each generated file on disk with the hash in the state record. It reports a changed or deleted file as drift.

title: reconciler.go
description: Builds the plan and the new state record from the service declaration and the registry. It gives each file one action: generate, update, delete or unchanged.

title: snapshot.go
description: Checks the plan against the world before apply writes. It refuses a plan whose registry digest or compiler build record does not match the live one.

title: stego CLI
description: Holds the stego commands. The drift command fails when a generated file no longer matches its hash. The version command prints the build record.

title: buildidentity runtime.go
description: Reads the compiler build record from the Go build metadata. The version command and the state record both use this one source.

title: qualify-compiler-release.py
description: Qualifies a compiler release at one exact commit. It selects CI runs by head commit. It requires a success conclusion for every named job. With --verify-release it installs the published release through the consumer path and compares every asset digest.

title: install-compiler.py
description: Installs a compiler from a published release. It refuses any platform other than Linux amd64. It checks the size and the SHA-256 digest of every downloaded asset.

title: verify-compiler-artifact.py
description: Authenticates the compiler and its build record before it copies them to the result directory. It requires a signature for both files. It requires the signed record to state Linux amd64 and the selected revision.
